Otis Redding – Live In Europe

Volt Records S-416 | Original 1967 Stereo Pressing

An original U.S. pressing of Otis Redding's legendary live album Live In Europe, released on Volt Records in 1967. Features electrifying performances of soul classics including "Respect," "I've Been Loving You Too Long," "My Girl," "Satisfaction," and "Try A Little Tenderness."

A great addition for collectors of Stax/Volt, Southern Soul, R&B, and classic live recordings.

Condition

Vinyl: G+

  • Retains good gloss
  • Light surface marks and hairlines consistent with age and use
  • No major cracks, warping, or damage observed
  • Visually graded

Jacket: G+

  • Moderate corner and edge wear
  • General shelf and ring wear
  • No major seam splits visible
  • Original jacket included

Please review all photos carefully as they are part of the description.

Album Information

Artist: Otis Redding
Title: Live In Europe
Label: Volt Records
Catalog Number: S-416
Format: LP, Stereo, 12" Vinyl
Country: United States
Year: 1967
Genre: Soul, Rhythm & Blues

Track Listing

Side One

  1. Respect
  2. Can't Turn You Loose
  3. I've Been Loving You Too Long
  4. My Girl
  5. Shake

Side Two

  1. Satisfaction
  2. Fa-Fa-Fa-Fa-Fa (Sad Song)
  3. These Arms Of Mine
  4. Day Tripper
  5. Try A Little Tenderness

Why Collect This Record?

Released during one of the most important periods in soul music history, Live In Europe captures Otis Redding at the height of his career and remains one of the definitive live soul albums ever recorded. Original Volt pressings continue to be sought after by collectors of Stax and classic R&B.
